title: Smoky Kung Pao Stir Fry
description: A spicy and savory Chinese dish made with marinated chicken, peanuts, and vegetables.
instructions: 1. Heat stir-fry oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
3. Remove chicken from the wok and set aside.
4. Add soy sauce, garlic, and ginger to the wok and stir-fry for 1 minute.
5. Add bell peppers and scallions to the wok and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
6. Return chicken to the wok and stir-fry for 1 minute.
7. Stir in peanuts and sugar, and cook for 1 minute.
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
9. Serve hot over toast or rice.
10. Garnish with additional peanuts and scallions if desired.
